items.title: Terri Lyne Carrington interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: My father, his name is Solomon Matthew Carrington III

ctx.x: Was your family active in the church?

No. My father, his name is Solomon Matthew Carrington III and his grandfather was a minister, and I think maybe even his father, his great grandfather may have been as well. But I think both my parents were forced kind of to go to church as a kid every Sunday and I think when I was born they decided not to do that, and if I wanted to I could, if I didn’t I didn’t have to. So I would go to church sometimes but they have pretty much left that discipline. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -9-
Was your interest in Buddhism, did it have anything to do with music or meeting people through music?
